traits.label: Acts on own responsibility
traits.text: Sickles advances his troops to a forward defensive line without explicit orders, citing the imminent threat of an enemy attack on his left flank.

citation.doc: Sickles, testimony of February 26, 1864 (Report of the Joint Committee on the Conduct of the War, vol. 1, scan)
citation.quote: I took it on my own responsibility

traits.label: Remonstrates against orders
traits.text: Sickles verbally objects to the withdrawal of Buford's cavalry from his left flank, expressing hope that at least a portion of the force would remain.

citation.doc: Sickles, testimony of February 26, 1864 (Report of the Joint Committee on the Conduct of the War, vol. 1, scan)

traits.label: Confident in holding position
traits.text: Sickles assures General Meade of his ability to hold the extended line until reinforcements arrive, despite acknowledging the difficulty of the task.

citation.doc: Sickles, testimony of February 26, 1864 (Report of the Joint Committee on the Conduct of the War, vol. 1, scan)
citation.quote: I assured him of my entire confidence in my ability to hold the position
